decisions.reason: The coolant pressure booster extends the firm's core coolant management offer, costs little to keep listed, and its value is still uncertain after only one year, so keeping the option open is worthwhile.
The cleaning centrifuge fits the firm's filtration competence, and with no negative evidence yet, it is a cheap option worth holding while demand becomes clear.
Coolant nozzles are a low-cost line that complements the firm's systems and supports cross-selling, so the carrying cost is low relative to the option value.
Scraper belt chip conveyors are a staple of the firm's chip conveyor portfolio with low incremental cost, so there is no evidence that would justify dropping them.
The magnetic belt conveyor serves a niche within the firm's established conveyor business, and its uncertainty has not yet resolved negatively.
Hinged belt chip conveyors are close to the firm's core offer and in steady demand from metalworking customers, so keeping them costs little.
